sentences.text: S1 (Aisha Bello) stated she is from the community mental health team and was referred by Dr Shah.
S2 (Callum Reid) confirmed his mother (Mum) told him Aisha was coming.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated his mother is at work.
S1 (Aisha Bello) explained that notes would be recorded on the team's record, shared with the GP, and disclosed to the crisis team if safety was a concern.
S2 (Callum Reid) agreed to the explanation of the recording process.
S1 (Aisha Bello) stated Dr Shah reported Callum has been feeling low.
S2 (Callum Reid) described his situation as 'rubbish' since about the summer and stated he dropped out of college in September.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he was studying Engineering at Level three and stopped going because he 'couldn't face it'.
S2 (Callum Reid) reported sleeping badly, stating he is up until four or five in the morning gaming, then sleeps during the day.
S2 (Callum Reid) reported eating not much, stating his mother leaves food and he mostly has toast.
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he has asthma and uses an inhaler.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he was working at a warehouse as a Christmas temp last year and has no work now. He reported his mother has been urging him to sign on.
S2 (Callum Reid) described his relationship with his mother as 'okay', noting she works a lot (mostly nights) and they do not really talk about things.
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed that his mother knows he is 'down' but not the rest of how he is feeling.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated he does not really talk to friends, except online with his mate Josh, and his sister is at university in Leeds.
S1 (Aisha Bello) asked if Callum had hurt himself when feeling low.
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he cuts his arms.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated the cuts happen 'most nights' for about two months now.
S2 (Callum Reid) reported the cuts are not deep, are healing all right, and he keeps his sleeves down.
S1 (Aisha Bello) proposed asking a nurse to look at the cuts.
S2 (Callum Reid) agreed ('I guess') to the proposal of a nurse looking at the cuts.
S1 (Aisha Bello) asked if Callum ever thinks about dying or ending his life when feeling at his worst.
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed he has wanted to die 'properly' for the last few weeks.
S1 (Aisha Bello) asked if Callum has thought about how he might do it.
S2 (Callum Reid) disclosed that last week he went for a walk to Calder Bridge, over the river, stood there thinking about jumping off, and then walked home.
S2 (Callum Reid) stated his mother and his dog, Bailey, stopped him from jumping off the bridge.
S2 (Callum Reid) described Bailey as a Staffy, three years old, who sleeps on his bed and is 'a good lad'.
S1 (Aisha Bello) asked if Callum had ever taken an overdose of tablets or anything.
S2 (Callum Reid) denied ever taking an overdose, stating 'No. Never. I've never done that.'
S2 (Callum Reid) reported he is not going to do anything today.
